title: Architect and implement: Real Estate lead funnels, pipelines, workflows, SMS & email nurturing

facts: California real estate brokerage, GoHighLevel architect, hourly. No client name stated.
Scope: seller and buyer funnels, opportunity pipelines, workflows, SMS and email nurture, calendars, webinar follow-up, AI lead qualification, agent recruiting funnel.

close.title: Measure how fast leads

close.caption: First we measure how your brokerage runs today, then we track the same numbers after launch.

metrics.name: Time to first text
metrics.definition: Median time from a funnel submission to the first text sent to that lead, reported separately for seller, buyer and webinar funnels.

metrics.name: Consults booked per 100 leads
metrics.definition: Distinct leads with a booked listing or buyer consult divided by all new leads from the same funnels in the same period, multiplied by 100.

metrics.name: Leads with an assigned agent
metrics.definition: Share of new leads that have an assigned agent within the agreed time after they come in, counted once per lead.

scenes.title: Route each seller lead in one workflow.
scenes.caption: The home value funnel tags {{lead.first}}, opens her opportunity and checks the AI score.
scenes.beat: Say {{lead.first}} fills out your home value funnel. She wants to sell within 60 days and has no agent. The workflow opens her opportunity in New lead, checks the tag from the AI scoring step, assigns {{owner.first}} and texts her a booking link. Leads that aren't ready go into a longer email nurture instead.
